# mcrl role

[Command reference](README.md)

Manage roles.

```text
Aliases:
  role, roles
```

| Subcommand | Description |
|---|---|
| [`role create`](#mcrl-role-create) | Create a role |
| [`role delete`](#mcrl-role-delete) | Delete a role |
| [`role list`](#mcrl-role-list) | List roles of a service |

## mcrl role create

Create a role.

```text
Usage:
  mcrl role create <service>:<role> [flags]

Aliases:
  create, new

Create a role in a service. Role names follow the same rules as service names.

API: POST /api/v0/services/<name>/roles
API key permission: Read, Write

Examples:
  mcrl role create web:app
  mcrl role create web:db --memo 'MySQL primary'

Flags:
      --memo string   memo
```

## mcrl role delete

Delete a role.

```text
Usage:
  mcrl role delete <service>:<role>

Aliases:
  delete, rm

Delete a role.

API: DELETE /api/v0/services/<name>/roles/<role>
API key permission: Read, Write

Examples:
  mcrl role delete web:old
  mcrl role delete web:old --yes
```

## mcrl role list

List roles of a service.

```text
Usage:
  mcrl role list --service <name> [flags]

Aliases:
  list, ls

List roles of a service.

To see the roles of every service, use "mcrl service list", which includes
role names.

API: GET /api/v0/services/<name>/roles
API key permission: Read

Examples:
  mcrl role list --service web
  mcrl role list --service web --jq '.[].name'

Flags:
      --service string   service name (required)
```
